what: dream_arm.py drives one arm at a time: --side auto scans both arms read-only, starts pickup_server on the cooler one and mirrors Saleh's prompt to that side; on a heat stop it returns the arm home and continues on the other arm if it is cool enough.
why: Motor heat limits each arm's reach; alternating keeps a demo going while the hot arm cools.
details: The idle arm's measured joints from the scan go to Dream as its state; --other-sdk is only needed with --side right|left.
Dry run (no motion) at 17:06: scan read left 49 C / right 46 C, chose right, Dream answered in 1.6 s with a 48-row chunk.
Every exit still ends with pickup_server rest; the server subprocess is never killed while its arm is enabled.
